messages.content:
Read one passage of a document about machines at work (law, manual, guidance, internal guideline,
plant record) and write down the important facts it states.

Answer with one line per fact, fields separated by " | ", nothing else, no header, no code fence:
subject | predicate | object | condition | quote
- predicate: a short camelCase verb phrase of your choice.
- condition: any condition or exception, or "" if none.
- quote: the words of the passage the fact comes from.
At most 12 facts. If the passage states nothing important, answer with the single word NONE.

Passage: REG, Art. 3(34)

(34) ‘lifetime’ means the period from the moment that machinery or a related product is placed on the market or put into service until the moment that it is discarded, including the effective time when the machinery or related product is capable of being used and the phases of transport, assembly, dismantling, disabling, scrapping or other physical or digital modifications foreseen by the manufacturer;

response.text:
machinery or related product | lifetimeStartsAt | moment placed on the market or put into service | "" | "the period from the moment that machinery or a related product is placed on the market or put into service"
machinery or related product | lifetimeEndsAt | moment it is discarded | "" | "until the moment that it is discarded"
lifetime | includes | effective time when machinery or related product is capable of being used | "" | "including the effective time when the machinery or related product is capable of being used"
lifetime | includes | phases of transport, assembly, dismantling, disabling and scrapping | modifications foreseen by the manufacturer | "the phases of transport, assembly, dismantling, disabling, scrapping or other physical or digital modifications foreseen by the manufacturer"
lifetime | includes | other physical or digital modifications | foreseen by the manufacturer | "the phases of transport, assembly, dismantling, disabling, scrapping or other physical or digital modifications foreseen by the manufacturer"
